name: Stillwater Plaza
summary: Stillwater Plaza is a commercial shopping center on Highway 6 in Manvel, TX, serving one of the Houston area's fastest-growing communities with 137.7% population growth in the past decade. The center offers premium commercial spaces in a strategic location just 5 minutes from Highway 288 and the expanding Manvel Town Center.
demographics: Stillwater Plaza serves a rapidly growing suburban market in Manvel, TX, which has experienced 137.7% population growth in the past decade. The trade area is characterized by young families moving into 12 master-planned communities with over 10,000 new homes planned in the next 5 years. The primary market consists of middle to upper-middle income households attracted to the area's new residential developments, with strong representation of families with school-age children given the proximity to Manvel High School. Shoppers in this area typically seek convenient access to everyday services and are drawn to the center's location just 5 minutes from the expanding Manvel Town Center and easy highway access to Houston.
description: Stillwater Plaza is a commercial shopping center strategically located at 19300 Highway 6 in the heart of Manvel, Texas, one of the fastest-growing cities in the Houston metropolitan area. Positioned just 5 minutes south of Highway 288 and only 25 minutes from downtown Houston, this plaza serves as a trusted destination for visionary business owners seeking premium commercial spaces in a thriving market. The center benefits from exceptional demographics, situated in an area that has experienced remarkable 137.7% population growth over the past decade according to the U.S. Census Bureau. With 12 rapidly expanding master-planned communities bringing over 10,000 new homes to the area within the next five years, Stillwater Plaza is perfectly positioned to serve this burgeoning population. The shopping center is conveniently located just 5 minutes from the rapidly expanding Manvel Town Center and within an 8-minute walk from Manvel High School, offering upscale amenities and fostering a vibrant community atmosphere for both businesses and shoppers alike.
